note: Both sets read stacked-area thickness charts, but Set A binds values to the correct airfoil/span charts and materials more often (e.g., CarbonUD ~45–50 mm at the 77% span LE region, foam ~8–10 mm, glass_uni at the TE, and correct airfoil-at-span identifications). Set B misassigns the ~55 mm and ~40 mm foam bands to glass_triax, places glass_uni at the leading edge where CarbonUD peaks, and reports foam/glass_triax values at the TE that belong to other layers. Set B also carries several claims with no airfoil or span condition and a contradictory pair of CarbonUD values (100 mm vs 80 mm) for the same location. Set A is not clean either — it invents a CarbonUD layer in the 100% span chart and a 40 mm glass_triax thickness — but it has fewer such errors and more useful, correctly conditioned claims.
